metadata.normalization: Combined: sum Share in All India (column N) over all states and sectors per item. Rural/urban: sum column N for that sector and item, divided by the all-item sector total, multiplied by 100.
metadata.definitionNote: Item names and COICOP hierarchy identify expenditure categories, not a single nationally identical product specification or rupee price. Source workbook does not disclose individual outlet quotations.
